it.name: Moonly: Your Spiritual Guide
it.d:
Moonly: your Personal Astrologer and Spiritual Guide 

Moonly is your daily Jyotish guide, built on precise astronomy — moon phases, lunar days (tithis), and New and Full Moon calculated for your exact location using high-precision astronomical algorithms. Your Birth Chart is built on Jyotish — Vedic sidereal astrology based on the real positions of constellations, calculated with the traditional Lahiri ayanamsa. Discover personalized horoscopes, guided meditations and powerful lunar rituals — rooted in real astronomy and ancient wisdom.

Daily Horoscope & Cosmic Guidance

No days are the same and your horoscope shouldn't be either. Get a personalized daily horoscope, rituals, and mindful tips based on your unique Birth Chart, so every morning starts with a little more intention.

Moon Phase Tracker & Lunar Calendar
The moon has its own rhythm — and when you follow it, life flows better. Track moon phases and celestial events with our precise lunar calendar, get tips to boost mood, focus, and creativity, and know exactly when to push forward or slow down. Add the moon phase widget to your home screen and explore Full moon rituals, New moon intentions, and retrograde guidance.

Your Personal Astrologer
Big decision ahead? Not sure about a relationship, a career move, or the right moment to act? Just ask. Chat with your personal in-app astrologer and get clear answers rooted in your Birth Chart in seconds.

Personal Transits & Astro Timing
Timing matters more than you think. Discover your personal green-light windows for big decisions, launches, and fresh starts and use cosmic timing to make every move count.

Meditation & Mindfulness 
Need to relax? Moonly's guided meditations — binaural beats, chakra healing, mantra sessions, and transcendental practices — help you find calm whenever you need it most. Build a daily mindfulness ritual that fits your life. Wind down at night with white noise, rain sounds, brown noise, and healing sleep frequencies designed to ease you into deep, restful sleep.

Affirmations & Manifestation
What you tell yourself every day shapes everything. Start each morning with positive affirmations aligned with lunar energy — designed to build real confidence and keep your manifestation mindset switched on. Add the affirmation widget to your home screen and let it work quietly in the background.

Birth Chart & Self-Discovery
Your Birth Chart (Natal Chart) is a map of who you are — and who you're meant to become. Built on Eastern Vedic Jyotish astrology, it reveals your karma, patterns, and deepest traits. Pair it with numerology insights and daily readings to support your journey of self-discovery and move through life's challenges with clarity and purpose.

Zodiac Compatibility
Why do some connections feel effortless and others feel like hard work? Explore zodiac compatibility for any relationship: romantic, friendship, or professional. Understand the strengths and the friction points before they surprise you.

Tarot & Runes
Sometimes you just need a different perspective. Gain clarity with tarot card reading and daily tarot sessions that provide insight into your life's path. Seek answers from ancient runes, a timeless oracle offering spiritual guidance for the present and future.

Spiritual Growth & Self Care
Dive into spirituality, spiritual awakening, ritual practices, witchcraft wisdom, and shadow work. Access tools for stress relief, anxiety relief, self-care, motivation, and gratitude. Explore healing practices and motivational quotes to support your glow-up journey and healthy mind.

Get your personal lunar guide, featuring meditation and mantra, sleep sounds, white noise, astrology, tarot, runes, affirmations, mindfulness tools, and cosmic insights — all in one app. Transform your routine and embrace harmony with lunar wisdom.

For entertainment purposes only.

Feel free to send your feedback: hi@moonly.app

moonly.app/terms

it.name: Precious - Baby Photo Art
it.d:
Precious is the cutest way to track your baby milestones and see your baby's development. This app AUTOMATICALLY organizes your baby photos into adorable monthly pictures, growth slideshows, a photo calendar journal, and MUCH more — all with no work required from you. App features require a Baby Art Pro subscription (3-day free trial included).

Precious uses Artificial Intelligence to find the absolute best photos of your baby and uses them to create photo stories that will melt your heart.

You can watch your baby grow up with the then vs now feature, smile at a slideshow of last weekend’s activities, or effortlessly browse older baby pictures in the Photo Calendar. Every one of your baby's monthly milestones is accompanied by beautiful photo frames & collages, made for you. Have fun with your photos by exploring the hundreds of unique stickers we have available to mark the fun activities you and your baby share. 

You just keep taking baby photos. Let Precious handle the rest.

--

Contact us:
If you have questions or suggestions, please email us at contact@preciousapp.com

--

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Precious is free to download. Everyone is welcome to a free 3-day trial period of the Baby Art Pro in-app-purchase. A free trial or purchase is required to access content.
- Subscribing to Baby Art Pro gives you access to our premium content and features
- There are weekly, monthly, and annual subscription options, with prices as listed in your localized app store ($4.99 per week in the United States)
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of your subscription
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and at the cost of the chosen package
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- Links to Your Privacy Policy and Terms of Use at https://www.preciousapp.com/privacy-policy and https://www.preciousapp.com/terms-conditions 
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication
- At the end of your subscription, you will be able to keep any content that your received while your subscription was active.

it.name: Paired: Couples & Relationship
it.d:
Welcome to Paired: the app that brings couples closer. Life can be messy, but your relationship doesn’t have to be. Paired helps you build better communication, manage conflict, and deepen your connection in just 5 minutes a day.

- 8 million downloads
- Apple App of the Day, August 2026
- Scientifically proven to increase relationship satisfaction
- Featured in The New York Times, BBC News, Bustle, and more

With Paired, you can:

- Make connection a daily habit: Daily questions allow you to effortlessly dedicate time each day to build strong communication, encourage intimacy, and strengthen your relationship.
- Pair with your partner: Add your answers and then unlock your partners responses to start a discussion, discover more about them and build a deep connection. 
- Celebrate every event, big or small: Use Paired to keep track of the important dates in your relationship, from the big ones like anniversaries and birthdays, to the small, significant moments, like your first kiss or your favorite date night.

With Paired Premium, you can:

- Reach your relationship goals: Our guided journeys support you in developing the skills you need to help your relationship to thrive, with activities and conversations each day to help you build healthy communication habits. 
- Focus on the topics that matter: Dive into any topic, from household finances to love languages, with guidance from experts to ensure sure it’s always healthy and productive.
- Check in with each other: Our games and quizzes are suitable for all stages of your relationship, whether you’re married, newly dating, or in a long-distance relationship. 

Join millions around the world using the Paired, the app for couples, to build happier, lasting relationships.

Questions? Suggestions? Let us know at support@paired.com.

*****

Please note that Paired and the materials and information contained herein are not intended to, and do not constitute medical, psychological, or mental health advice, or diagnosis, and may not be used for such purposes. You should always consult with a qualified physician or mental health professional about your specific circumstances.

Our Privacy Policy: https://www.paired.com/privacy_policy.html
Our Terms and Conditions: https://www.paired.com/terms_and_conditions.html

it.name: Alfred Camera: Home Security
it.d:
We are the world’s most popular and top-rated security camera app for iOS phones, with over 90 million families around the world choosing AlfredCamera to turn their old phones into powerful home security cameras, baby monitors, pet cams, and more.

AlfredCamera is an all-in-one home security camera app providing more features than a expensive CCTV security camera system. It's live cam with instant intruder alert is perfect as a security camera, baby monitor, nanny cam, pet monitor, dog monitor, and more.

AlfredCamera is well-recognized as:
“One of the Best App Options for Setting up Your Phone as a Security Camera” － CNET (Feb 2023)
“Home Protection is Achieved at Low Cost and Without Many Complications” － Infobae (June 2021)

FEATURES
Whether you’re looking for a surveillance camera app or webcam app to keep an eye on your belongings, a baby camera app to look after your newborn, a pet cam app or dog camera app to entertain your lovely pets, the AlfredCamera home security camera app is the perfect solution for your smart home.

24/7 LIVE STREAM: Watch high-quality live video from anywhere with Alfred's live camera stream. 
SMART INTRUDER ALERT:  Get instant alerts when movement is detected
LOW-LIGHT FILTER: Enhanced visibility at night for your nanny cam, pet monitor.
WALKIE-TALKIE: Deter thieves, interact with visitors or pets, and soothe babies.
360 CAMERA: Cover a larger area with both lenses.
ZOOM, SCHEDULE, SOUND DETECTION, REMINDER, TRUST CIRCLE, SIREN, and more...
Works smoothly via WiFi, 3G, and LTE.

SUPER EASY TO SET UP
AlfredCamera is the easiest-to-install surveillance camera system with professional-grade features that allows you to DIY your own home security camera, pet cam, baby cam or nanny cam in few minutes:

STEP 1: Install Alfred Camera App on two devices, your old phone becomes the camera, your current device is the viewer
STEP 2: Scan a QR code to pair them.
STEP 3: Your two devices connect and work together effortlessly

ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
Unlike traditional CCTV cameras or home surveillance cameras, AlfredCamera app is a portable CCTV camera, place it anywhere for extra security. It works great as a nanny cam, baby camera, or dog monitor while traveling, renting an Airbnb, or simply checking in during work hours.

SIMPLE SECURITY AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
With a crystal clear live camera stream, instant alerts and events recorded, Alfred will help you to always know what’s happening and keep evidences in any incident.

Monitor pets when you're away with a reliable dog camera or pet cam
Check on elderly family with real-time remote video access
Sound alerts and night vision on your pet cam, baby camera, or dog camera
Protect your home with smart motion-triggered alerts
Create a smart CCTV system, your own pet cam, baby camera, or dog camera using just two phones and the Alfred app.

SMART, CONVENIENT, ECO-CONSCIOUS
First time choosing a CCTV camera app or home security system? The best home surveillance camera app you can ever find: reliable, versatile, and easy to use.

Everyone is taking advantage of their old smartphones by turning them into video players, GPS navigators, or fitness devices. So why not use yours as a pet monitor, dog monitor, baby monitor, nanny cam, webcam, or IP cam?

Alfred Premium offers a subscription service that will be charged to your account. The account will be automatically charged for renewal. You can manage your subscription and auto-renewal by going to Account Settings.

Want to learn more about how to monitor your home? Please visit our official website https://reurl.cc/jvKWrM

Some features of this app require Device Administrator permission.

it.name: Adult Coloring Book - Pigment
it.d:
= = =

Coloring is a great way to relax and reduce stress and anxiety. Just 10 minutes of coloring can provide the same benefits as meditation. It helps you practice mindfulness, stay present, enhance concentration, build creativity, and is a great alternative to games!

Pigment, an award-winning coloring app, is a sanctuary for relaxation, nourishing your creative spirit, and providing daily inspiration. Within its vibrant community of artists, you'll discover a wealth of positivity and wholehearted encouragement.

Enjoy thousands of coloring pages and tools and brushes you won’t find anywhere else. Immerse yourself in a coloring experience that lets you draw, paint and color as you would on paper, with 30+ different pencils, markers, and brushes. 

Beginner? Try our Tap-To-Fill mode. Advanced? Check out Freehand, Automatic, and Advanced modes for a more nuanced experience.

Import your own images, or choose from our huge collection of illustrations and grayscale images including flowers, mermaids, people, animals, landscapes, anime, mandalas, and tons more! Or start with a blank page and use Pigment as a sketchbook.

Easily share your creations with friends and family via social media, email, text - even print them for framing!

= = =

10,000+ PAGES
* The largest artwork collection available with over 10,000 professionally illustrated pages. Over 800 pages for free users.
* Gorgeous hand-drawn coloring pages from independent artists.
* New coloring pages added daily, and new books added every week!
* Access to exclusive Marvel content.

AWARD-WINNING TOOLS
* Pigment is the only coloring book app that simulates pencil, markers, and paintbrush strokes for a realistic coloring experience.
* More than 30 kinds of coloring tools - including Colored Pencil, Marker, Paint Brush, Glitter, Pastel, Airbrush, Watercolor, Wood Grain, Blender, Fade, Bloom and more!
* "Tap-to-fill" and traditional coloring modes.
* An unlimited number of colors are available using the color wheel and innovative shade control slider.
* Try our professional color palettes, or create and save your own!
* Premium Access provides unlimited access to the entire library, premium brushes, and exclusive color palettes.

THE GALLERY
* Find inspiration in the Pigment Gallery, a supportive community where you can share your work and see pages colored by others. 
* Make real friendships with people who share your interests – chat, tag, and learn from each other.
* Learn tips and improve your skills with tutorials and tips from the community. 

BFF with iOS
* Share your work by printing pages, through email, text, Facebook, Instagram, Pigment Gallery, and other social networks.
* Fully supports finger, Apple Pencil, and third-party stylus inputs.
* Adjust pressure, direction, and size of stroke using Apple Pencil.

Some screenshots feature work by Cindy Primeau, Elaine Durham and Angela Zeman.

= = =

PIGMENT PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION

Pigment Premium has three pricing options:
$4.99 USD per week
$9.99 USD per month
$59.99 USD per year (this is 4.99/month – huge savings)

Get free Premium Access for 7 days with a free trial. After the free trial, your subscription will be automatically renewed.

These are prices for US customers, pricing in other countries might vary.

Prices are subject to change. Premium Access automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 

Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage Premium Access subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a Premium Access subscription.

= = =

it.name: CHANI: Your Astrology Guide
it.d:
CHANI is the #1 astrology app made by real astrologers — not AI. Designed to make astrology accessible and useful, it combines ancient astro wisdom with mindfulness tools to help you unlock your full potential, tap into your personal power, and live out your life’s purpose. With CHANI, you can…

GROUND INTO EACH DAY:
- Understand how the day’s astrology will land for you and get tips on how to work with it with daily horoscopes.
- Center yourself with a guided meditation highlighted to support the day’s astrological energy.
- Create lunar magic with real-time readings that update with the Moon's movements.

PREP FOR WHAT’S NEXT:
- Check the astroweather forecast and ﻿tune in to the Astrology of the Week Ahead podcast for a breakdown of how the upcoming astro is showing up in the collective and on the world stage.
- Listen to your weekly reading for a deeper, personalized look at how each week’s events will manifest in your life, and advice on how to make the most of them.
- Work with the astro as it unfolds with weekly rituals, tarot cards, personalized journal prompts, and audio offerings curated to help you meet the moment — from New Moons and Full Moons to retrogrades, eclipses, and more.

EXPLORE THE BLUEPRINT OF YOUR PURPOSE:
- Uncover each planet and point’s position in your birth chart and learn how their positions and relationships play a role in your life. Then dig into your detailed astro insights and discover the gifts and challenges that your natal placements bring to the table.

TRACK THE LESSONS OF YOUR TRANSITS:
- Keep tabs on what sign each planet is currently in, whether or not it’s retrograde, and what all of that means for you personally with timely planetary horoscopes.
- Access the wisdom that expert astrologers draw on (aka hyper-personalized transit readings) to learn how the planets are interacting with your unique birth chart at this exact moment.

RESET YOUR NERVOUS SYSTEM + MANIFEST ABUNDANCE:
- Browse our full library of guided meditations, affirmations, frequencies, and sleep stories to ground, decompress, dream, and access your inner wisdom.

GROW THROUGH WHAT YOU GO THROUGH:
- Overcome obstacles, transform your life, and ﻿reconnect with yourself through CHANI courses like the 7-part Saturn Return course and the viral 28-day Breakthrough course.

FIND OUT WHAT THE FUTURE HOLDS:
- ﻿Look ahead and unpack your year with personalized month-by-month readings, a zoomed-out astro overview, annual horoscopes for the four main areas of your life, and a collection of rituals, journal prompts, altar suggestions, and guided meditations dedicated to each of the year’s main themes.

ADD (AND READ) YOUR FRIENDS’ CHARTS:
- Access unlimited charts and save up to 100 for easy reference.
- Get to know your besties on another level with in-depth insights into their natal placements and their chart’s gifts and challenges.
- Toggle between chart and table view for an at-a-glance astro overview.
- Refresh your Astro 101 knowledge with interactive chart elements.

WHO WE ARE:
CHANI is a queer, feminist-led company that is anti-AI and not VC-funded. We’re on a mission to make astrology accessible and to support everyone in living their purpose — because we believe that astrology is a tool that can help transform us and our world for the better. We also believe that good business prioritizes personal wellbeing and promotes economic justice. No one on our team is paid less than $80K before benefits, and we offer a four-day workweek; fully covered health, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited menstrual leave; and more. In addition, 5% of all our company’s revenue is disbursed directly to survivors of gender-based violence via freefrom.org, and we’ve generated over $3.5 million for survivors to date. By choosing CHANI, you are investing in human talent, environmentally conscious technology, mutual aid, and mindful community.

it.d:
Discover JournalCircle, a journaling app featured on the App Store across multiple regions. JournalCircle combines AI-powered journaling, voice notes, mood tracking, and entry analysis to help you record your daily life with clarity. Users often mention that the clean, beautiful design makes them want to journal more consistently.

JournalCircle is a journaling and life log app designed to manage your diary, mood, routines, goals, and daily records in one place.

AI-powered journaling tools
JournalCircle offers a range of AI features including voice journaling, AI-generated prompts, and automatic entry analysis to help you reflect more easily and understand patterns in your thoughts and emotions.

Voice journaling and smart analysis
Record journal entries using your voice when typing feels inconvenient. JournalCircle converts speech to text automatically and analyzes your entries to provide helpful insights over time.

Mood, routine, and goal tracking
Track your mood daily, set personal goals, build routines, and review your progress with clear visual summaries. JournalCircle helps you see how your emotions and habits change over time.

Flexible journal views
Switch between weekly, monthly, and yearly views to review your entries at your own pace and better understand the bigger picture of your life.

Designed to support consistent journaling
Many users say that JournalCircle’s calm, well-designed interface makes journaling feel effortless and encourages them to write more often.

JournalCircle helps you keep a structured, meaningful record of your life—without unnecessary friction.

Download JournalCircle and start building a clearer daily record today.

it.name: DayGram - One Line a Day Diary
it.d:
• App Store Best of the Year • Best New App • Featured in App Store Stories

Capture each day in one quiet line with a private, distraction-free E-Ink journal.

DayGram makes journaling feel small enough to keep. Write one line when that is all you need, or keep going when there is more to say. Its warm, paper-like design keeps the focus on your words instead of menus, prompts, or noise.

WHY DAYGRAM?

• No ads and no subscriptions.
• Protect your journal with a password and Face ID.
• DayGram supports iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.

PREMIUM, ONCE

Unlock Premium with one purchase:

• Keep entries backed up and in sync with iCloud.
• Add multiple photos to preserve the moments around your words.
• Use all themes and borders, or choose your own background photo.
• Turn handwritten notes into text with built-in OCR.
• Export your Book of Days as a beautifully formatted PDF to keep or print.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

According to its current App Store privacy label, DayGram does not collect data. Your journal remains a personal place for thoughts, gratitude, memories, and everyday life.

Start with one line today. Over time, those small entries become a personal record you can revisit for years.

Questions or feedback? Contact 153branches@gmail.com

Clarido helps you decide what matters, turn it into one clear intention, and keep it visible through personalized wallpapers, Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets, and Apple Watch.

Clarido combines focus, mindfulness, and gentle accountability so your goals stay present when life gets distracting.

HOW CLARIDO WORKS

1. FIND WHAT MATTERS

When everything feels important, talk it through with Clarido. Use voice or text to share your competing priorities, goals, or challenges.

Clarido’s AI coach listens, asks thoughtful questions, and helps you identify the one thing that deserves your focus most right now.

2. CHOOSE ONE INTENTION

Turn what matters into a clear, personal intention — something specific enough to guide your choices and meaningful enough to carry with you.

Clarido helps you find the intention within the bigger dream, narrow an overwhelming goal into a realistic next focus, and put it into words that feel like your own.

3. KEEP IT VISIBLE

Your intention shouldn’t disappear inside another journal, planner, or productivity app. Put it somewhere you already look:

- Personalized Lock Screen wallpapers
- Lock Screen widgets
- Home Screen widgets
- Apple Watch

Every time you see it, your intention becomes a quiet reminder of what you chose before notifications, distractions, and other people’s priorities take over.

4. REFLECT MORE DEEPLY

Clarido can create personalized, AI-generated guided audio reflections shaped around what you’re navigating.

Each reflection draws from the context you’ve shared, giving you space to slow down, listen, and explore what may be underneath your thoughts and decisions.

5. CHECK IN

Clarido follows up with a daily lightweight check-in: Did you actions align with your intention today?

There are no streaks to protect and no complicated system to maintain. Just a small moment to notice how you’re living.

6. KEEP MOVING FORWARD

Recommit to your intention, refine it as circumstances change, or choose what comes next.

Clarido remembers what you’ve shared over time. The more context it has, the more personally relevant its coaching and guided reflections become. It can notice recurring patterns, connect past conversations to what you’re experiencing now, and help you avoid starting from zero every time.

BUILT FOR INTENTIONAL LIVING

Clarido is for people who want to:

- Focus their energy on what matters most
- Stop drifting through life on autopilot
- Stay connected to their goals without obsessively tracking them
- Make more mindful daily decisions
- Find clarity during a complicated season
- Turn a big dream into one achievable focus
- Become more accountable to themselves
- Keep personal priorities visible when life gets busy

ONE INTENTION AT A TIME

Intentional living doesn’t mean controlling every minute or optimizing every part of your life.

It means choosing what deserves your attention, giving it a place in your daily life, and noticing whether your choices reflected it.

When one intention has served its purpose, Clarido helps you find the next one. That’s not starting over. That’s the practice.

SUBSCRIPTION

Clarido is free to download and use. You can create your own intentions and keep them visible on your Lock Screen and Home Screen without a subscription.

A subscription unlocks:

- The AI coach
- Personalized, AI-generated guided audio reflections
- Check-in notifications
- Memory and pattern recognition
- Auto-updating Lock Screen wallpapers
- Apple Watch experiences
- A 30-day intentional living challenge, with a gift when you complete it
- More ways to keep what matters visible and stay connected to your intention

Manage or cancel your subscription anytime through your App Store settings.

it.name: I Am Sober
it.d:
I Am Sober is more than just a free sobriety counter app.

Along with tracking your sober days, it helps you build new habits and provides ongoing motivation by connecting you to a wide network of people all striving for the same goal: staying sober one day at a time.

Through our growing sober community you can learn from others and contribute by sharing insights and tactics that have worked for you.

**The I Am Sober app features:**

• Sober day tracker
To visualize how long you’ve been sober.

• Remember why you quit
Add reasons and photos to help you remember why you want to quit your addiction and stay sober.

• Daily pledge tracker
Take a pledge every day. Sobriety is a 24-hour struggle, so start your day off by making a pledge to stay sober. Then you can review how your day went and log notes at the end of the day.

• Sobriety calculator
View how much money & time you’ve saved by being sober.

• Analyze triggers
Recap each day and find patterns that made your day easier or more challenging than the last.

• Share your story
Either with others or for yourself, take photos and journal your progress directly in the app. Then choose to share it or save it as a reminder for yourself.

• Milestone tracker
Track and celebrate your milestones from 1 day, to 1 week, to 1 month and beyond. Compare experiences with others on their sober journey. Read how they felt at this milestone and what you can expect. If you’re struggling, share your story and invite others to offer help or advice.

• Withdrawal timeline
When you create an account and declare your addiction, you can instantly see a withdrawal timeline to get an idea of what to expect for your next few days (and weeks). What’s more, you can contribute to it. See how many others saw an increase in their restfulness vs those that saw an increase in anxiety. Prepare yourself for what’s to come in recovery.

• Customize your experience
You set the time, your sober birthday, the category of motivation you need, the addictions you’re trying to break, even the end-of-day summaries. Make the app customized to your lifestyle and tailored to your needs.

**Sober Plus subscriptions**

I Am Sober is free to use, but you can support development of the app with a subscription to Sober Plus. With Sober Plus, you'll get access to these premium features:

• Create a group
Stay accountable together and track your sobriety privately. Groups are great for complimenting your real-world group like Alcoholics Anonymous, NA, SA, SMART Recovery, or your rehab center.

• Locked access
Keep your trackers private with a lock that you can access via TouchID or FaceID.

• Data Backups
Save your progress in the cloud and restore your trackers if you get a new device.

• More tracking
Track more addictions and get access to more communities. Even if your addiction is specific like Wine, Online Shopping, or Skin Picking, you’ll find a variety of communities of people who are all trying to get sober from alcohol, drugs, eating disorders, self-harm, and more.

Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. I Am Sober Plus automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

it.name: Kitchen Stories Easy Recipes
it.d:
Kitchen Stories is your ultimate digital cookbook, recipe keeper, and meal planner for everyday cooking! Discover thousands of chef-tested recipes, get inspired by culinary creators, and learn new cooking techniques step-by-step. Whether you want a quick weekday meal, healthy dinner ideas, or baking inspiration, Kitchen Stories makes cooking easy, delicious, and perfect for any occasion.

### NEW: THE ULTIMATE SOCIAL MEDIA RECIPE KEEPER
Found a brilliant recipe on Instagram or TikTok? With Kitchen Stories Plus, you can save and organize social media recipes from external platforms directly into your personal digital cookbook with just one click. No more chaotic screenshots or lost links. Keep all your food inspiration in one organized space!

### DISCOVER & COOK NEW RECIPE IDEAS
* Thousands of guided recipes tailored for every taste, dietary style, and skill level.
* From quick 20-minute weekday dinners to healthy meal prep options and festive baking.
* Detailed, step-by-step cooking instructions with high-quality photos.

### YOUR PERSONAL DIGITAL COOKBOOK & RECIPE ORGANIZER
* Save your favorite recipes and organize them into custom cookbooks and collections.
* Keep track of the recipes you loved, the ones you want to try; and create as many cookbooks as you like
* Use the recipe manager to import and keep track of everything you love to cook in one place.

### MEAL PLANNING
* Effortless meal prep: Find delicious and quick lunch and dinner recipes for the week ahead.
* Personalized recipe suggestions tailored to your specific dietary preferences (vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, etc.) and what you have in your pantry
* Create a sustainable kitchen: Generate perfect dishes from leftovers to reduce food waste 

### CONVENIENT GROCERY LISTS
* Shopping lists that aggregate ingredients and quantities for easy grocery shopping.
* Access your list on the go, making weekly meal prep completely stress-free.
* View your grocery list by recipe or the combined one for all recipes

### WHAT OTHERS SAY ABOUT US:
“The most well-thought-out cooking app on the German market.” – STERN
“Makes even complicated recipes easy enough for anyone to cook.” – Süddeutsche Zeitung
“Finally an app that brings order to recipe chaos.” – BRIGITTE

Join millions of home cooks and download Kitchen Stories today to elevate your everyday cooking!

Questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you at hello@kitchenstories.com

Terms of Use: https://www.kitchenstories.com/en/terms/

*EDITORS' CHOICE & APP OF THE DAY*

Keep your plants alive. Without guesswork.
Planta helps you identify plants, understand their needs, and care for them with confidence. Get a complete care guide at the exact moment your plants need it.

Identify any plant in seconds
Take a photo to instantly identify your plant and receive a tailored care plan based on its species and needs.

Never forget to care for your plants
Use our smart tracker to create personalized schedules for watering, fertilizing, repotting, pruning, misting, and more. Care reminders adapt to your home environment, local weather, and plant type.

Fix plant problems before it’s too late
Yellow leaves, brown spots, pests, or slow growth? Dr. Planta analyzes symptoms and guides you step by step with clear treatment recommendations.

Understand light conditions in your home
Use the built-in light meter to find the right spot for each plant and avoid common light-related mistakes.

Track progress and build better habits
Log care activities, monitor plant health over time, and document growth in your personal plant journal.

Share care when you’re away
Going on holiday? Invite family or friends to help with plant care and see completed tasks in real-time for total peace of mind.

Learn from other plant owners
Join a community of plant lovers to share tips, ask questions, and grow your confidence as a plant parent.

Add plants instantly with AI glasses from Meta
Just look at a plant to add it, no typing needed.

Planta is trusted by millions of users to help their plants survive and thrive. Whether you’re caring for your first plant or a growing indoor jungle.

Let Planta turn you into a confident, thriving plant parent!

Whether you're looking for tops, dresses, shoes, jeans, skirts, accessories, etc, you'll find them in over 35 categories. Search for your favourite fashion designers, brands, or items on sale. Once you've created an outfit, share it with your friends and followers and get their instant feedback.

combyne is communication
Follow your friends, favourite bloggers and style icons, or any other user. Share your outfits with them or comment on their outfits. The combyne feed will keep you up to date on what the people you follow have been combining and you can tell them what you think of it.

combyne is inspiration
Our fashion team carefully curated a selection of fashion trends, must-haves, outfits and looks. With combyne you'll never miss the latest trends, always get great fashion advice and browse every day for new clothes. 

combyne is Community
Get matched and find your fashion soulmate, who thinks and dresses just like you! The chat feature lets you share your looks immediately with your friends and receive quick feedback. 

combyne is a fashion challenge
Our users create Outfit Challenge every day. Create your look following the rules of the challenge, rate the others' looks, get the most likes. 

combyne is online shopping
You can buy every item or outfit directly via the app at over 50 partner shops and brands. With one click, we will forward you to your favorite item in the online shop or current sale.

combyne is your virtual wardrobe
Save your favourite items and outfits, name them by event or style and never lose track of your wardrobe again.

combyne Features:
- Combine personal outfits and find new looks
- Get new fashion tips und share them with friends
- Follow friends, bloggers and style icons and comment on their outfits
- Create an individual looks
- Save your favourite outfits
- Get fashion-matched with your style-soulmate
- More than 50 online shops
- More than 1.000 fashion brands

Great, finally everything I need in regards to fashion all in one app:

1. Inspiration from other users that I can use.

it.name: WeChef - Recipe Organizer
it.d:
DISCOVER WECHEF: YOUR ALL-IN-ONE RECIPE & MEAL COMPANION

WeChef transforms the way you cook, plan, and explore new dishes. From turning leftovers into something exciting, to saving recipes from the web, or organizing meals for special occasions – WeChef makes cooking easier, more fun, and stress-free. It’s your go-to partner for creating tasty, well-organized, and unforgettable meals.

SEARCH RECIPES BY INGREDIENTS
Turn your fridge into inspiration! Just enter what you have on hand, and WeChef will suggest creative recipes that help you minimize waste and maximize flavor. From veggies sitting in the fridge to random pantry staples – transform them into meals you’ll actually love. Cooking smarter has never been this easy.

IMPORT RECIPES FROM THE WEB
Spotted a great recipe online? Simply paste the link into WeChef, and it will pull in the ingredients, steps, and photos for you. Build your own personalized recipe library with favorites from across the web and keep everything organized in one place. Never lose track of your go-to recipes again!

DIGITIZE RECIPES WITH THE SCANNER
Bring your handwritten notes, cookbooks, or magazine clippings into the digital age. With WeChef’s smart OCR scanner, you can convert family recipes or PDFs into editable, searchable text – and keep those culinary treasures safe forever, accessible anytime, anywhere.

MOOD-BASED RECIPE SUGGESTIONS
Not sure what you’re craving? Just tell WeChef how you feel, and get recipe ideas that match your mood. Comfort food, quick & healthy bites, or festive treats – WeChef’s smart algorithm makes sure you always land on the perfect dish.

SIMPLIFIED MEAL PLANNING
Plan your meals like a pro! Add recipes to your calendar, generate shopping lists, and even set reminders so dinner is always on time. Whether you’re prepping for the week or planning a family feast, WeChef keeps everything organized and stress-free.

SURPRISE MODE FOR ADVENTUROUS COOKS
Feeling spontaneous? Let WeChef surprise you with a random recipe! Explore new cuisines, rediscover old favorites, and add some excitement to your meals. Who knows what delicious adventure awaits?

EFFORTLESS PORTION ADJUSTMENTS
Cooking for one or feeding a crowd? WeChef automatically adjusts recipe quantities for perfect portions every time. No more guessing or wasted ingredients – just accurate, reliable measurements tailored to your needs.

INTERACTIVE RECIPE ORGANIZER
Save and organize your recipes beautifully. Sort by type, occasion, or rating, add personal notes and photos, and find your favorites in seconds. Your collection has never looked this good – or been this easy to use.

ADVANCED RECIPE SEARCH
Looking for something specific? Search by name, ingredient, category, or dietary need. Whether it’s a gluten-free dinner, a quick breakfast, or a clever way to use leftovers, WeChef helps you find exactly what you need in no time.

WHY CHOOSE WECHEF
WeChef isn’t just another recipe app – it’s your personal kitchen assistant. From inspiration and planning to cooking and sharing, it makes every step of the journey easier, more fun, and more delicious. Say goodbye to the daily “What’s for dinner?” struggle, and hello to endless possibilities.

WE’D LOVE YOUR FEEDBACK
Your opinion helps us grow! Share your ideas, suggestions, or feedback at support@wechef.site and help shape the future of WeChef. Together, we’ll make cooking even more inspiring and stress-free.

it.name: Crouton: Recipe Manager
it.d:
Crouton is simple feature packed recipe organizer & meal planner. The best place to store your favorite recipes from where ever you find them, websites, cookbooks or a handwritten note from your Grandma.  

IMPORT ANYWHERE
Crouton supports importing recipes from almost everywhere! Pull recipes automatically out of websites and just save the bits you need. You can also scan recipes straight out of your recipe book using AI and OCR 

PLAN YOUR WEEK
With your favourite recipes on hand, Crouton makes it very easy to plan your meals for the week (or even long into the future). If you’re stuck for recipe ideas let Crouton automatically generate the meal plan from your organized dinner recipes.

STEP BY STEP MODE
Crouton offers a unique step by step mode. Focus on one recipe step at time as you cook, you can tap on ingredients within a step to get the quantity (saves you jumping back and forth between the steps and ingredients). With hands free mode you can move between steps without touching your device! Perfect for when you have messy hands.

TIMERS
Start timers with a tap. Crouton detects times within recipes and lets you start timers straight from the steps. A convenient heads up display keeps the times front of mind while you continue to use the app.

GROCERY LISTS
Create shopping lists directly from your recipes, easily copy just the ingredients you need to your list. Integrates with Reminders for convenient access. Your groceries have never been easier!

CLOUD SYNCING
All of your recipes are conveniently synced between all of your devices using iCloud. 

RECIPE FEEDS
Save your favourite recipe RSS feeds into Crouton to see new recipes as they’re published from your favourite blogs.

AI IMPORTING
Quickly import recipes using AI. Import a recipe from a single photo with no manual entry required. Also supports plain text and images. 

FAMILY SHARING
Share your recipes with friends and family using iCloud, so everyone knows what’s for dinner.

GUIDED WEIGHING
Pair to supported Bluetooth scales (such as the Acaia coffee scales) and have Crouton guide you through weighing your ingredients, avoid the mental juggling of recipe steps and amounts

COMBUSTION PROBE SUPPORT
Crouton pairs with Combustion's temperature prove to provide live updates on your cook

Crouton also offers a range of customization including custom icons and app colors.

it.name: Find Phone: Device Tracker

Keep Your Loved Ones Safe with Phone Tracker

Phone Tracker – Family Locator is your go-to app for staying connected with family and friends in real-time. Whether you’re ensuring your kids get home safely, checking in on loved ones, or locating a lost phone, Phone Tracker has you covered.What can you do with Phone Tracker?

- See real-time locations of your family, friends, and loved ones anytime.
- Check location history to keep track of past movements.
- Get notified when circle members arrive or leave home, school, or other important places.
- Create private groups (Circles) to share locations with the people you trust.

More than just a location tracker:

- Geofence Zones: Set virtual boundaries and receive alerts when someone enters or leaves a designated area.
- SOS Alerts: In an emergency, send an instant alert with your live location to all circle members.
- Find a Lost Phone: Use GPS tracking to locate a lost or stolen device.
- Secure & Private: Phone Tracker cannot be installed remotely or used for secret surveillance. Users must install the app manually and approve location sharing.

Phone Tracker is your reliable GPS-based family locator and personal tracking app, designed to help keep your loved ones safe. It is not intended for spying or secret surveillance, and it cannot be installed remotely or without consent. To use the service, the user must install the app manually and approve the location-sharing request. By subscribing you can enjoy unlimited alerts, real-time tracking, extended location history and many more features!

Terms of Use: https://tou.ichnoshypodema.org/

Privacy Policy: https://pp.ichnoshypodema.org/

Stay connected and enjoy peace of mind, knowing your loved ones are safe.

Download Phone Tracker now and keep your family secure!

it.name: Salatuk - صلاتك
it.d:
Salatuk is your Muslim prayer companion.

By automatically locating you, this app provides appropriate prayer times and the direction of the Qibla corresponding to your position.

Salatuk's algorithm supports a large number of calculation methods adopted in the Islamic world. Depending on your location, the app chooses the appropriate method and Fiqh school. However, you also have the option to manually change this information in the 'Settings' tab if you wish.

Salatuk is currently available in 3 languages: Arabic, English, and French.

***** Important Note ***** 

If you are familiar with Salatuk on other systems, please note that this version DOES NOT SUPPORT certain functions like "Silent mode after Adhan," "Full Adhan," or the use of a "Custom Athan." This is due to technical limitations that we will try to remove once the iOS system allows it.

***** About Prayer Times ***** 
Please note that we pay great attention to the accuracy of prayer times. However, in some countries, these times may not be exact. In such cases, please refer to the official Islamic institutions in your locality and manually adjust the prayer times in the app settings.

***** About the Adhan ***** 
Salatuk reminds you that it is time for prayer using "4 takbeerats" instead of the full Adhan.

*****  Tips for Better Use ***** 
To refresh prayer notifications, it is recommended to open the app frequently (once a day). This should also be done when you change location or time (daylight saving time).

it.name: Zest: Meal Planner & Recipes
it.d:
Tired of cooking the same 3 meals on repeat? Zest integrates a mind-blowing cooking education into your routine. Learn to cook with us through step-by-step explanations of foundational cooking concepts in fewer than 10 minutes and dishes that bring the concept to life. Our recipes are created by two former Michelin star chefs, distilled by a home chef, and cooked by you, the superstar home cook that you are (or will be). We don't assume any prior culinary knowledge. We meet you where you are and help you improve.
 
Stop copying traditional recipes - start learning from Zest. We've cooked those delicious Bon Appetit dinners. But when we took away the recipes we felt like lost puppies. Zest is designed to teach you the how's and why's of cooking. So when the recipe is gone you can confidently navigate the kitchen. The promise: Taste improvement after one dinner with Zest.

FEATURES:

STEP-BY-STEP INSTRUCTIONS
We've all tried cooking a TikTok recipe. You rewatch the video 13 times to figure out what the hell is going on. Zest embeds videos throughout recipes so you can click into content when you need it. No more pausing and restarting. Learn at your own pace.
 
CONCEPT VIDEOS
Watch a short video on a new concept at your own pace and then cook recipes that reinforce what you've learned. We dive into topics like the science of tasting and the basics of seasoning, sautéing, roasting and more!

SKILL VIDEOS
Don't know how to dice an onion? Don't be embarrassed, we got you covered. Skill videos are linked in each recipe to guide you along, so you don't have to watch Gordon Ramsey on YouTube (we love his accent too).

CURATED MENU
Choose a menu to fit your preferences. Tired of wasting produce? Search for dishes including what’s already in your fridge. Got allergies? Compile safe recipes in your menu to find them when you’re ready to get cooking. 

GROCERY LIST
Shop your menu with our automated grocery list. Plus, utilize our helpful tips while you shop. Don't know what a neutral oil is? We got you covered.

PERSONALIZED RECOMMENDATIONS
Rate the recipes you cook, so we can recommend similar ones.

Feedback? Technical Issues? Killer ideas you want to contribute to make our app better? Email us at support@zestapp.co. We're always here to help and would love to chef up new ideas together!

- Those who set multiple alarms minutes apart

- Those who want to make successful morning & evening habit with the full motivation

*Night Sleep Routine: Habit to Combat Insomnia
1. Set your target sleeping time and set up a 'Bedtime Reminder' and wake-up alarm.
2. When it's bedtime, turn on the sleep tracker and calm sounds.
3. Maintain this routine for over 5 days to see changes in your sleep cycle, and complete your perfect night routine!

it.name: Watch Faces by Facer
it.d:
Explore 500,000+ Apple Watch faces with Facer, including thousands of free designs and officially licensed brands like Fallout, Star Trek, Tetris, Pac-Man, and more!

From classic analog styles and fitness dashboards to playful characters, pop culture favorites, and artistic designs, Facer helps you personalize your Apple Watch like never before.

Find the perfect watch face for every style, mood, and occasion — or create your own and share it with the world.

OFFICIAL WATCH FACES FROM ICONIC BRANDS

Discover officially licensed watch faces featuring:
Fallout • PAC-MAN • Tetris™ • Star Trek • Call of Duty • Ghostbusters • Street Fighter • Frida Kahlo • Popeye • Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles • Hot Wheels • Dungeons & Dragons • The Smurfs • SpongeBob SquarePants • and many more.

New brands, artists, and collections are added regularly.

EXPLORE EVERY STYLE

•  Analog Watch Faces
•  Digital Watch Faces
•  Hybrid Watch Faces
•  Health & Fitness Watch Faces
•  Data-Rich & Utility Watch Faces
•  Entertainment Watch Faces
•  Character & Pop Culture Watch Faces
•  Artistic & Creative Watch Faces
•  Sports Watch Faces
•  World Time & Astronomy Watch Faces
•  Seasonal & Event Watch Faces
•  Luxury-Inspired Watch Faces

WHY MILLIONS CHOOSE FACER

• 500,000+ handcrafted watch faces
•  The world's largest watch face collection
•  Officially licensed brands and characters
•  Thousands of free watch faces
•  New watch faces added every day
•  Watch faces created by real artists and designers
•  Personalized watch faces for every style
•  Premium watch faces and exclusive collections
•  Multi-platform compatibility across Apple Watch, Wear OS, and more
•  Easy watch face discovery, customization, and sharing

CREATE YOUR OWN WATCH FACES

Want something truly unique?

Use Facer Creator at facer.io/creator to design your own watch faces and share them with the world. No coding required.

Join a global community of creators and showcase your designs to millions of smartwatch users.

THE ULTIMATE APPLE WATCH CUSTOMIZATION APP

Facer makes it easy to:
• Customize your Apple Watch
• Personalize your smartwatch
• Discover new watch faces
• Find official branded watch faces
• Explore fitness, sports, artistic, and utility designs
• Create and share your own watch faces
• Express your style directly from your wrist

MULTI-PLATFORM SUPPORT

Facer supports Apple Watch and other leading smartwatch platforms, allowing your favorite watch faces to follow you as you upgrade devices.


QUICK SETUP FOR APPLE WATCH

1. Install the Facer app on your iPhone
2. Ensure Facer watch app is installed on your Apple Watch
3. Browse thousands of free and premium watch faces
4. Tap ‘Send to watch’ on your favorite face
5. Apple Watch app on your iPhone will open and add the face to your list of faces there and then set it on your Apple Watch (*Note: the face may appear blank/black in the Apple Watch iPhone app until you close and reopen that app after the face downloads)

SUPPORT

Questions, suggestions, or need help?
Visit help.facer.io or contact support@facer.io
If you're enjoying Facer, we'd greatly appreciate an App Store review!

CONNECT WITH FACER

Official website: www.facer.io
Community Forum: community.facer.io
Instagram / X / Snapchat / Tiktok / Youtube: @facer_io
Reddit: /r/Facer

LEGAL

Terms of Service: www.facer.io/terms
Privacy Policy: www.facer.io/privacy

it.name: Best Brew Guide: Filtru Coffee
it.d:
Coffee is more than just a way to wake up in the morning, it's a way of life. With Filtru, you'll make the perfect cup each and every time and learn as you go.

Filtru is your go-to app for learning and replicating the best way to make your favorite coffee. Gone are the days of pouring water over coffee and throwing in some milk! Filtru will tell you how much coffee to use, when and how much water to pour, how to stir, and so much more. By the time you've tasted a Filtru coffee, you'll wonder how you ever lived without it! Those just starting out will enjoy our augmented reality (AR) gear guides that put new accessories right on your kitchen counter, giving you a chance to take a look before splashing out on a new coffee gadget!

Coffee fans new and old will love our growing collection of community brew guides, products from our partnered coffee roasters, and more. We live for coffee and we know you do too – let's live for it together via a curated feed of new coffee ideas while learning new brewing methods.

With Filtru, a specialized Espresso guide will offer tips on the grinding of beans and more to ensure the next cup is even better than the last. You'll learn by tasting, rating the flavor as you go, and Filtru will show you which variables to change for an even better taste.

Already living your best coffee life? Filtru integrates with a wide range of the world's best Bluetooth digital scales – perfect for weighing an exact amount of coffee for your morning cup. We'll even show you a timer alongside an illustration of the correct water flow speed to ensure you get the best possible flavor. No more guessing measurements and techniques and then hoping for the best!

Filtru ships with coffee recipes for the most popular brewing methods on the planet and distils everything into an easy-to-use app that won't get in the way of what's important – taste. Looking for some inspiration? Filtru helps you discover new brewing guides submitted by the community as well as the pros including Scott Rao and James Hoffmann, alongside other Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) certified baristas. Have a particularly killer coffee recipe of your own? Share it via Filtru so everyone can enjoy it!

▶ Filtru includes the following recipes:

- Espresso (Dial-in, Short recording and more)
- Chemex
- AeroPress
- Hario V60 (Pour over)
- Bonmac Dripper
- Beehouse Dripper
- Kalita Wave
- Clever Dripper
- Moka Pot (Espresso)
- French Press (Cafetiere)
- Siphon (Vacuum)
- Cezve (Turkish)
- Vietnamese Drip (Phin)

▶ Supported Bluetooth digital scales:

- Acaia: Pearl, Pearl S, Lunar, Pyxis and Cinco
- Atomax Skale 2
- Blackcoffee
- BooKoo Themis
- Decent Scale
- DiFluid Microbalance and Microbalance Ti
- Escali SmartConnect
- Eureka Precisa
- Felicita Arc, Incline and Parallel
- Fresco Drop
- Goat Story GINA
- Hiroia Jimmy
- Reflex Wireless Smart Chef
- Timemore Black Mirror Dot and Black Mirror 2
- Varia AKU Micro, Mini and Pro
- Wilfa Precision Uniform

▶ Filtru PRO includes the following premium features:

- Access to additional brew guides
- Augmented Reality Gear Guides
- Coffee Logs
- Espresso Dial-In
- Espresso Shot Recording
- Extraction Calculator (TDS Refractometer required)
- Advanced Siri Shortcuts
- Custom App Icon
- Live Activities
- Lock screen widgets
- Home screen widgets
- Advanced App Shortcuts and App Intents

Happy Brewing!

* Privacy Policy: https://getfiltru.com/privacy.html
* Terms of Use: https://getfiltru.com/terms.html

it.name: GetFree - Discover Free Apps
it.d:
GetFree — Indie App Community

Discover quality apps from independent developers. Join a passionate community of app enthusiasts who share honest reviews, connect directly with creators, and support the indie app ecosystem.

DISCOVER APPS WORTH YOUR TIME

Tired of scrolling through the same top charts? GetFree surfaces hidden gems from independent developers and small studios who pour their hearts into creating exceptional apps. Our community-driven feed highlights innovation, quality, and craftsmanship—helping you find apps that truly deserve attention.

Browse curated apps across categories like Productivity, Photo & Video, Games, Health & Fitness, Education, Music, Utilities, Lifestyle, Finance, and Business. Whether you're looking for a powerful tool or an engaging game, GetFree helps you discover apps before they hit mainstream popularity.

COMMUNITY FEATURES

• Honest Reviews: Share detailed feedback about apps you've tried. GetFree reviews encourage real discussion and live within GetFree—completely separate from the App Store—creating a trusted space for genuine community opinions.

• Direct Developer Access: Talk directly to the people who built the app. Developers respond to feedback and engage in real conversations. Your voice actually reaches the creator.

• Discussions: Connect with fellow app enthusiasts. Share tips, compare experiences, ask for recommendations, and discover hidden gems through community wisdom.

• Upvotes & Recognition: Help quality apps rise to the top. Earn badges for meaningful contributions—become a trusted voice in the community.

• Personalized Recommendations: Get app suggestions tailored to your interests. The more you engage, the better your recommendations become.

SUPPORT INDIE DEVELOPERS

Behind every app on GetFree is an independent developer or small team working hard. Independent developers sometimes share official App Store promo codes with our community—their way of thanking early supporters. When codes are available, community members can claim them to try new apps.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Browse & Discover: Explore apps by category or recommendations
2. Read & Research: Check reviews, notes, and discussions
3. Download: Get apps directly through the official App Store—safe and seamless
4. Engage: Optionally share your thoughts to help fellow members

WHY GETFREE?

• Curated quality over popularity
• Real community, not bots or fake reviewers
• Direct access to developers
• No pressure—everything is optional
• Honest reviews from real members

ABOUT GETFREE

GetFree is a companion community for app discovery, not a marketplace.

• All downloads happen through Apple's official App Store
• Community feedback is always voluntary—never required or incentivized
• Promo codes are official Apple codes shared at developer discretion
• GetFree reviews are separate from App Store ratings and have no effect on App Store rankings
• Promo code redemptions cannot generate App Store reviews—ensuring authentic App Store ratings
• Codes are distributed to engaged members—not mass promotion
• Developers are verified before joining
• We prohibit manipulation and fake reviews

We believe great apps deserve discovery on their merit.

GETFREE PRO

• Priority access to newly listed apps
• Early notifications for codes
• Ad-free browsing
• Enhanced recommendations

it.name: Zen Flip Clock - Minimal Timer
it.d:
Zen Flip Clock

A minimalist flip clock, desk clock, and focus timer designed to make time clear, simple, and easy to follow.

Choose from multiple clock themes, including flip clock, digital clock, and minimalist styles. Use it as a fullscreen clock for studying, working, focusing, or as a clean nightstand clock. Open the app and start right away.

Why Zen Flip Clock

More than just a clock, Zen Flip Clock is a simple tool for focus and time management. From study sessions and focused work to everyday timing, it helps you stay aware of your time and make every minute count.

Key Features

Multiple Clock Themes
Choose from flip clock, digital clock, and minimalist clock designs. Use your favorite theme as a desk clock, fullscreen clock, or nightstand clock for work, study, and everyday use.

Pomodoro Timer
Stay focused with the built-in Pomodoro timer. Perfect for studying, reading, working, and other tasks that require concentration.

Count Up Timer
Track elapsed time for studying, workouts, meditation, reading, and everyday activities.

Hourly Chime
Stay aware of time with hourly chimes and customizable reminders. Build better routines for work, study, and daily life.

Focus Statistics
Track your focus time and usage to better understand how you spend your time.

Personalization

Multiple Themes
Switch between a variety of minimalist clock themes, from classic flip clock designs to clean digital styles.

Smooth Animations
Enjoy clean, natural, and fluid clock animations designed for a calm visual experience.

Home & Lock Screen Widgets
View the time at a glance with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets without opening the app.

Easy Controls

Swipe left for Pomodoro
Swipe right for Count Up Timer
Tap to open Settings

Whether you need a flip clock for your desk, a fullscreen digital clock for studying, a Pomodoro timer for focused work, or a simple nightstand clock, Zen Flip Clock keeps time clear and focus simple.

Make time visible. Stay focused.

it.name: Alfred Camera: Home Security
it.d:
We are the world’s most popular and top-rated security camera app for iOS phones, with over 90 million families around the world choosing AlfredCamera to turn their old phones into powerful home security cameras, baby monitors, pet cams, and more.

AlfredCamera is an all-in-one home security camera app providing more features than a expensive CCTV security camera system. It's live cam with instant intruder alert is perfect as a security camera, baby monitor, nanny cam, pet monitor, dog monitor, and more.

AlfredCamera is well-recognized as:
“One of the Best App Options for Setting up Your Phone as a Security Camera” － CNET (Feb 2023)
“Home Protection is Achieved at Low Cost and Without Many Complications” － Infobae (June 2021)

FEATURES
Whether you’re looking for a surveillance camera app or webcam app to keep an eye on your belongings, a baby camera app to look after your newborn, a pet cam app or dog camera app to entertain your lovely pets, the AlfredCamera home security camera app is the perfect solution for your smart home.

24/7 LIVE STREAM: Watch high-quality live video from anywhere with Alfred's live camera stream. 
SMART INTRUDER ALERT:  Get instant alerts when movement is detected
LOW-LIGHT FILTER: Enhanced visibility at night for your nanny cam, pet monitor.
WALKIE-TALKIE: Deter thieves, interact with visitors or pets, and soothe babies.
360 CAMERA: Cover a larger area with both lenses.
ZOOM, SCHEDULE, SOUND DETECTION, REMINDER, TRUST CIRCLE, SIREN, and more...
Works smoothly via WiFi, 3G, and LTE.

SUPER EASY TO SET UP
AlfredCamera is the easiest-to-install surveillance camera system with professional-grade features that allows you to DIY your own home security camera, pet cam, baby cam or nanny cam in few minutes:

STEP 1: Install Alfred Camera App on two devices, your old phone becomes the camera, your current device is the viewer
STEP 2: Scan a QR code to pair them.
STEP 3: Your two devices connect and work together effortlessly

ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
Unlike traditional CCTV cameras or home surveillance cameras, AlfredCamera app is a portable CCTV camera, place it anywhere for extra security. It works great as a nanny cam, baby camera, or dog monitor while traveling, renting an Airbnb, or simply checking in during work hours.

SIMPLE SECURITY AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
With a crystal clear live camera stream, instant alerts and events recorded, Alfred will help you to always know what’s happening and keep evidences in any incident.

Monitor pets when you're away with a reliable dog camera or pet cam
Check on elderly family with real-time remote video access
Sound alerts and night vision on your pet cam, baby camera, or dog camera
Protect your home with smart motion-triggered alerts
Create a smart CCTV system, your own pet cam, baby camera, or dog camera using just two phones and the Alfred app.

SMART, CONVENIENT, ECO-CONSCIOUS
First time choosing a CCTV camera app or home security system? The best home surveillance camera app you can ever find: reliable, versatile, and easy to use.

Everyone is taking advantage of their old smartphones by turning them into video players, GPS navigators, or fitness devices. So why not use yours as a pet monitor, dog monitor, baby monitor, nanny cam, webcam, or IP cam?

Alfred Premium offers a subscription service that will be charged to your account. The account will be automatically charged for renewal. You can manage your subscription and auto-renewal by going to Account Settings.

Want to learn more about how to monitor your home? Please visit our official website https://reurl.cc/jvKWrM

Some features of this app require Device Administrator permission.

With more than 310,000 menus and 55,000+ grocery, convenience and retail stores across 4,000+ cities in the U.S., Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, DoorDash offers the greatest online selection of your favorite restaurants and stores, delivered wherever you are. Plus, enjoy $0 delivery fees for your first order. Restrictions apply: https://drd.sh/tF5uns/

IT’S ALL HERE
- Restaurants: Local and national favorites
- Grocery: Everything from fresh produce to household items
- Convenience: Snacks, drinks, OTC medicines, and more 
- Retail: Including gym must-haves, beauty supplies, etc.
- Pet supplies: Treats, toys, and everything they need
- Flowers: For special occasions or just because

KEY FEATURES
- On-demand, same-day delivery 
- Advanced delivery scheduling 
- Real-time order tracking
- No order minimums
- No-contact delivery by request
- Convenient payment options: Apple Pay, Venmo, PayPal, credit card, or SNAP/EBT at participating merchants
ENJOY UNLIMITED $0 DELIVERY FEES WITH DASHPASS
Get unlimited $0 delivery fees and up to 10% off eligible orders from restaurants, grocery stores, and more. Plus, DashPass members get access to exclusive items and offers, and 5% in DoorDash credit back on eligible pickup orders. Your first 30 days on DashPass are free, then your membership auto-renews at $9.99/month. Cancel anytime.

NATIONAL RESTAURANT PARTNERS
McDonald’s, Starbucks, Chick-fil-A, Burger King, Wendy’s, Chipotle, The Cheesecake Factory, Outback Steakhouse, Panera, Chili’s, Subway, Dunkin’ Donuts, Jamba Juice, Panda Express, Moe’s, P.F. GROCERY DELIVERY PARTNERS
Safeway, Albertsons, ALDI, Sprouts Farmers Market, Meijer, Hy-Vee, Grocery Outlet, Winn-Dixie, Smart & Final, BJ’s, Vons, Weis, ACME, Raley’s, Fresh Thyme, Giant Eagle, Bashas’, Bristol Farms, and more. 

CONVENIENCE & RETAIL DELIVERY PARTNERS
Walgreens, 7-Eleven, CVS, Rite Aid, Dollar General, Wawa, Sheets, Casey’s, Total Wine, BevMo!, PetSmart, Sephora, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Tractor Supply, and more.

FIND RESTAURANTS AND STORES NEAR YOU
We’re growing and currently serving over 4,000 cities across the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, including cities such as New York City, Los Angeles, Toronto, Vancouver, Melbourne, Sydney, Montreal, and more.

it.name: Watch Faces Wallpapers
it.d:
Watch Faces Wallpaper is a free apple watch wallpaper app that you can download many beautiful 3D wallpapers for your Apple Watch.

We have various categories for latest wallpaper :
- Abstract
- Cartoons
- Animals
- Flowers
- Car & Bikes
- Nature 
- Storm
- Red
- Fruits
- Grass
- Graffiti
- Desert
- Fire
- Love
- Light
- Quotes
- Wave etc.

We are continuously adding many more wallpapers with range of categories.

How to set Wallpaper to Watch :


- Choose any from the list Faces and press on it

- See the preview on watch model

- Tap "Set Watch Face" it will open share menu and from there you can set wallpaper as background on watch (for this you must have to connect watch to device first.)

- Take a look on your Watch to let the impression happen!

- Enjoy beautiful watch look

Please, make sure your Apple Watch is paired with the device on which installed this application.

Note: Apple Watch and imagery is copyright to Apple Inc. This Watch Faces Wallpapers is in no way affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Apple Inc. 

Credit : All wallpapers are taken from unsplash.com which is free of use (royalty free), so credit goes to Unsplash.

Privacy Policy : https://wisdomlogix.com/app/faces/privacy_policy.html

Terms of Services : https://wisdomlogix.com/app/faces/terms-and-services.html

it.name: I Choose You: For Couples
it.d:
A 2-minute daily ritual for couples. Answer questions you'd never think to ask, send photos from your day, and actually feel close again.

You check your phone hoping for something. A random text. A stupid meme. Anything that says "you crossed my mind." It's just silence. Or worse — "can you grab milk."

Nothing's wrong. You're "fine." But fine feels lonely. Fine feels like roommates who kiss sometimes. Fine feels like you're the only one who notices something's missing.

I Choose You makes "thinking of you" something you can actually see.

— HOW IT WORKS —

Every day, you both get 3 questions you'd never think to ask each other. Scratch to reveal. Answer with text, a photo, a drawing, or a GIF. When you both answer — you see each other's.

That's it. 2 minutes. Even he can do that.

— THE QUESTIONS HIT DIFFERENT —

Not "how was your day." Not therapy homework.

• "Who's more likely to cry at a commercial?"
• "What's something you've never told me about your childhood?"
• "Rate our intimacy this week — honestly."

3 000+ couple questions from silly to deep. The ones you'd never ask out loud but always wanted to know. After you both reveal — see how thousands of other couples answered the same thing.

— SEND A PHOTO FROM YOUR DAY —

• Snap front + back camera at once
• Add a doodle or short message
• Shows up on their home screen widget — all day
• No filter, no caption — just "I wanted you to see this"

That's what "thinking of you" looks like when it's visible.

— DRAW SOMETHING TOGETHER —

A shared canvas on both your phones. Leave a doodle, a love note, a badly drawn heart. Take turns. Add to each other's art. It's your thing.

— STREAKS THAT ACTUALLY MATTER —

• Complete the daily challenge together → streak grows
• 7 days. 30 days. 100 days. Unlock rewards along the way
• Miss a day? One free restore per month
• Because life happens, but showing up shouldn't stop

— VIBE CHECK —

Some days you can't explain how you feel. So just slide 5 bars: connection, quality time, intimacy, laughter, appreciation. Your partner does the same. You see both.

No more "I'm fine" when you're not.

— YES, THERE'S A FART BUTTON —

25 sounds. Sends a notification they can't ignore. Because sometimes love is stupid and that's the whole point. A bigger silly soundboard: Bee, Burp, Sitar, iMessage, Apple Pay, Sus, Trumpet, "What the hell?!", and more. Even custom sound. Record your own short voice clip and send it as your partner's notification sound. Hold to record, release to send.

— MADE FOR REAL COUPLES —

• Long distance or living together
• Dating or married for decades
• Busy professionals or new parents
• Anyone who wants to feel close again

— ONE SUBSCRIBES, BOTH GET EVERYTHING —

No ads. No data selling. No strangers. If either of you goes premium, your partner gets full access too. Just you two.

— THIS WORKS —

5,000+ couples. 2 minutes a day. Not because we fixed their relationship. Because we gave them a reason to show up for each other — every single day.

You want to feel chosen. Not once, at the beginning. Every day.
This is how.

Privacy Policy — https://ichooseyou.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA) — https://ichooseyou.app/terms.html

it.name: Inspo - Recipes & Meal Planner
it.d:
All your favorite social media recipes in one place!

Import recipes from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and any website. Inspo uses AI to instantly extract ingredients, step-by-step instructions, nutrition facts, and more from any recipe link. Inspo makes cooking effortless — from saving to shopping to serving.

SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
• Save recipes from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Safari with one tap using the Share Sheet
• Import recipes from photos, camera, or by pasting text
• Generate brand new recipes with AI — just describe what you want to cook
• Paste any recipe URL or add your own manually

COOK WITH CONFIDENCE
• Follow recipes step-by-step in Cook Mode — swipe through instructions hands-free
• Scale ingredients up or down for any serving size
• Convert between metric and imperial units
• View calories, protein, carbs, and fat with a visual macro breakdown

ORGANIZE YOUR COLLECTION
• Create folders to organize recipes by cuisine, meal type, or however you like
• Search recipes by name, ingredient, or keyword
• Bulk organize unorganized recipes in seconds

MEAL PLANNING
• Plan your meals for the week with a weekly calendar view
• Add recipes to any day — breakfast, lunch, or dinner
• Browse by folder or search when building your plan

SMART GROCERY LISTS
• Auto-generate grocery lists from your recipes
• Adjust serving sizes and pick which ingredients you need
• Duplicate ingredients are automatically merged

INSPO PREMIUM

Inspo includes both a free version and a subscription version with premium features. Upgrade to Inspo Premium to unlock:

• Unlimited recipe saves
• AI recipe generation
• Photo and camera recipe import
• Nutrition information for every recipe

Inspo offers an optional auto-renewing subscription. Payment will be charged to your Apple/Google account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime from your account settings.

it.name: Lake: Coloring Book for Adults
it.d:
Discover a world of relaxation and self-expression with Lake, the award-winning coloring app loved by millions.

Explore hand-drawn illustrations by independent artists and dive into a friendship of colors and brushstrokes right on your trusty iPad or iPhone. Unleash your creativity, nurture your artistic side, and discover the incredible impact coloring can have on your overall well being!

Start your free trial today and make a difference by supporting artists from all corners of the world.

SPARK YOUR CREATIVITY
- Get creative with the ultimate coloring tool set featuring a selection of artistic brushes. They're like magic wands but better!
- Explore our Rainbow with over 700 color shades. Who knew there were so many hues to choose from?
- Discover a variety of palettes as diverse as our drawings. From skin tones to hand-picked palettes, the choice is yours.
- Access any color you can imagine with the Color Picker. Your perfect shade is always just a tap and a glide away.
- A manageable number of coloring surfaces. You'll never feel overwhelmed!
- Color inside or outside the lines. The power is in your hands.
- Import a drawing from your device or snap a photo of it, then make it your own with color.
- Draw and color freely on a blank canvas and turn your own line art or sketches into coloring pages.
- Color with a reference and recreate drawings colored by artists.
- Learn all about Lake with video tutorials. From tools to techniques - everything you need to color with ease.

TAKE CARE OF YOUR WELLBEING
- Color drawings with a mood palette based on your current vibes.
- Need to vent or reflect? Jot down your thoughts in a coloring journal while creating beautiful masterpieces.
- Immerse yourself in the soothing sounds of brushes with our ASMR feature.
- Break out of your comfort zone with our curated Book of the Week and challenge yourself to reach new artistic horizons.

SUPPORT THE ARTISTIC COMMUNITY
- Take your pick from over 1500 exclusive drawings, carefully crafted to ignite your imagination.
- Explore artworks by over 100 independent artists, personally selected by Lake's editorial team.
- Revel in the magic of coloring hand-drawn illustrations
- Celebrate new drawings landing in Lake at least once a month with a 12-page coloring book exclusively designed for Lake.

LOVED BY APPLE AND OUR COMMUNITY
- Apple Design Award 2017
- "Lake offers a rewarding and relaxing coloring book experience for all ages. It brings together local and renowned artists with their fans through high-quality curated illustrations. Prepare to create a masterpiece!"- Apple, Inc.
- "If you're a supporter of working artists, you simply can't miss this coloring book app. It's bursting with incredible illustrations and gets updated all the time!" - Lory Gil from iMore
- “I love this coloring app and it has been so helpful for my mental health, especially during the difficult days.” - K. Davis, Lake user

In case you were wondering, Lake works offline and syncs seamlessly with your iCloud. No more worries about losing your precious colorings or journal entries. We've got your back!

For an even better experience, we recommend using an Apple Pencil. It's like a magic wand that enhances your journey through Lake's colorful universe.

So what are you waiting for? Grab your iPads or iPhones and get ready for a colorful adventure in Lake!

Got any suggestions or comments? Drop us a line or a DM at:

Email: info@lakecoloring.com
Instagram: @lakecoloring
TikTok: @lakecoloringapp

Terms of Service: https://www.lakecoloring.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.lakecoloring.com/privacy/

it.name: Pestle: Recipe Manager
it.d:
Save recipes from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and more with Pestle.

IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE
Import recipes from anywhere on the internet to Pestle, and keep just the ingredients and steps. Just tap 'Share', and 'Save to my Cookbook'. 

GUIDED COOKING
Turn any recipe into a step-by-step process with Pestle's guided cooking experience. Control Pestle hands-free for those messy recipes, set as many timers as you want & get reminders for quantities with just a tap.

DEVICE SYNC
Find a recipe on your iPhone, and cook it for dinner on your iPad with seamless, instant sync. For the power users, you can even switch between your iPad & iPhone with Handoff.

HOUSEHOLDS
Create a Pestle Household and share all of your recipes with your family, and create Meal Plans together, too!

DISCOVER
Pestle learns where you save recipes from and suggests to you their latest creations. Add your favorite foodie blogs and always stay up to date.

MEAL PLAN
Pestle can help you plan out your next 14-days by allowing you to assign recipes to each day. And, of course, syncs everywhere.

SHOPPING LIST
Take every ingredient from your recipe and add it to your shopping list! Already got Olive Oil? No worries, just tap it to remove it from your list.

BOOKMARKS
When Pestle isn't able to intelligently extract recipe details, Bookmarks are saved to take you straight back to the source.

RECIPE SCANNING
We get it, not all recipes are online. If you have a big collection of physical recipes, worry not, Pestle has a recipe scanner to digitize them! 

There's a lot more you can do with Pestle, but we'll let you discover it!


The use of Pestle is outlined in our Terms of Use, which can be found at https://pestlechef.app/terms.
